note.description: one line: what you compared against, or why the lens doesn't apply

kind.description: author: a question for the PR's author. existing: a note on code that was already there, for the reviewer (Area standards only)

evidence.description: links to the PR's own code (label starting 'PR:'), to prior art (label starting 'Base:') and to written rules (label starting 'Rule:')

job.description: one clause naming the job both the PR code and the prior art do

siblings.description: how the sibling sites that do this job handle it, with a count, e.g. "3 of 4 tools in mcp/tools declare their own schema"

author_reason.description: the reason the PR code comments or description give for this choice, quoted briefly; empty when none

file.description: the file the question is about, repo-relative as in the diff; for kind existing, the existing file it is about

lines.description: line range at the PR head, e.g. 40-52

example.description: what the suggestion would look like in the code; all three empty when the question isn't about a code change

before.description: the PR's code now, copied exactly from the PR head, starting with a comment naming its file and lines

after.description: the same code with the suggestion applied: a new helper's definition first, then the changed call site

replaces.description: two or three sentences: how many places the change touches, what stays as it is and why, and whether it's a move or a behavior change (so whether it's a nit)
